acquisition method: The MS analysis was performed in a data-dependent manner with full scans (m/z 300–1400) acquired using an Orbitrap mass analyzer at a mass resolution of 120,000.
cleavage agent: Tryptic peptides were dissolved with 10 μl of loading buffer (5% methanol and 0.1% formic acid)
collision energy: All the tandem mass spectra were acquired using the higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) method with normalized collision energy of 27%.
enrichment method: Distinct isoforms of CCAR1 were immunoprecipitated with Protein A-G agarose from A549 cells stably expressing Flag-CCAR1L and Flag-CCAR1S with endogenous CCAR1L/S depleted.
fragmentation method: All the tandem mass spectra were acquired using the higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) method with normalized collision energy of 27%.
instrument: The samples from in-gel digestion were analyzed on a Q-Exactive HF MS (Thermo Fisher Scientific) interfaced with an Easy-nLC 1,200 nanoflow LC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: A total of 340 and 147 (for CCAR1L and CCAR1S, respectively) unique proteins were identified with the detection of at least one unique peptide at 1% false discovery rate (FDR)
